correctness.rationale: A zero must be flanked by unlike nonzero colors, so zero sets are independent. For a k-zero set with k<n/2, the required unlike-color edges form a forest on n-k positions with k edges, giving 2^(n-2k) legal colorings. Cyclic gap compositions give n/(n-k) binom(n-k,k) zero sets; the alternating endpoint has exactly two zero patterns and colorings iff n/2 is even, giving four, otherwise zero. The standard cycle matching trace yields the square-root expression and the parity correction. The minimum counts are the top nonzero coefficients: 4, 2n, and n^2. Direct brute enumeration for 3<=n<=12, an independent 9-state transfer for 3<=n<=60, and recurrence checks for 3<=n<=150 passed on the new package code. Boundary n=3 and multigraph succession at n=4 are handled by distinct cyclic succession edges. Infinite quantifiers rely on the combinatorial proof.

value.rationale: The motivating October 2026 work settles a natural extremal weight, leaving the full labelled-size distribution and degeneracy of optima unaddressed. The result gives every coefficient for every cycle size, reduces the polynomial to a standard matching polynomial plus one parity correction, and yields a sharp constant/linear/quadratic residue-class census of optimal placements. The parity of the closed alternating-color constraint supplies a structural explanation, rather than an arbitrary small computation.
